apps.name: Krita
apps.label: painting
apps.about: Digital painting and drawing, with brushes, layers and frame-by-frame animation.

apps.name: Blender
apps.label: 3D
apps.about: 3D modeling, sculpting, animation and rendering, plus video editing.

apps.name: Pictogrep
apps.label: picture search
apps.about: Finds your local pictures from a plain-language description and turns references into rough storyboards.

apps.name: Inkscape
apps.label: vector drawing
apps.about: Vector drawing for logos, icons and illustrations that scale to any size.

apps.name: Scribus
apps.label: page layout
apps.about: Desktop publishing: lay out pages for books, zines and posters, with text frames and print-ready PDF export.

apps.name: Aseprite
apps.label: pixel art
apps.about: Pixel art and pixel animation, with onion skin and sprite sheet export.

apps.name: Godot
apps.label: game engine
apps.about: Game engine for 2D and 3D games, with its own editor and scripting language.

apps.name: LÖVE
apps.label: 2D games
apps.about: Makes 2D games from small Lua scripts.

apps.name: TIC-80
apps.label: fantasy console
apps.about: A tiny retro computer for making games, with built-in code, sprite, map and music editors.

apps.name: Pure Data
apps.label: sound patching
apps.about: Makes sound and music by connecting boxes in a visual patch.

apps.name: Orca
apps.label: live sequencer
apps.about: Live coding sequencer: a grid of letters that sends notes to synths.

apps.name: Processing
apps.label: creative coding
apps.about: Code sketches that draw and animate, made for artists learning to program.

apps.name: Pixelorama
apps.label: pixel art
apps.about: Free pixel art editor with layers, animation and tilesets, made with Godot.

apps.name: Pencil2D
apps.label: 2D animation
apps.about: Hand-drawn 2D animation with frames on a timeline, like a flipbook.

apps.name: GrafX2
apps.label: retro paint
apps.about: A 256-color paint program in the style of 1990s DOS painting.

apps.name: Goxel
apps.label: voxels
apps.about: A voxel editor: build 3D pictures one cube at a time, then export them.

apps.name: Blockbench
apps.label: low-poly 3D
apps.about: Low-poly 3D models and animations for games, pixel art and props.

apps.name: XaoS
apps.label: fractals
apps.about: Zoom into fractals in real time with the mouse, and save the views you like.

apps.name: Mandelbulber
apps.label: 3D fractals
apps.about: Renders 3D fractals with lighting and camera controls.

apps.name: MilkyTracker
apps.label: music tracker
apps.about: A music tracker like the old Amiga and PC ones: notes typed into a grid.

apps.name: Furnace
apps.label: chiptune
apps.about: A chiptune tracker for the sound chips of old consoles and computers, like the Game Boy and the NES.

apps.name: VCV Rack
apps.label: modular synth
apps.about: A virtual modular synthesizer with free modules, like a Eurorack case on your screen.

apps.name: Bonzomatic
apps.label: live shaders
apps.about: Live shader coding: write GLSL and watch the visuals change as you type.

apps.name: AzPainter
apps.label: full-color paint
apps.about: Full-color painting for illustration and drawing, lighter than Krita, and not installed by default.

apps.name: Typst
apps.label: typesetting
apps.about: Turns plain text markup into typeset PDFs, like a faster LaTeX.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.label: recording
apps.about: Records your screen and camera, or streams them live.

apps.name: Audacity
apps.label: audio editing
apps.about: Records and edits audio: cut, clean up and mix sound.

apps.name: mpv
apps.label: video player
apps.about: A small, fast video player that plays almost any file, with keyboard controls and scripts.

apps.name: Audacious
apps.label: music player
apps.about: A light music player for local files, with playlists and a classic look.
